title: Parallel Repetition for the GHZ Game: Exponential Decay
authors: Mark Braverman (Princeton University, USA), Subhash Khot (New York University, USA), Dor Minzer (Massachusetts Institute of Technology, USA)
abstract: We show that the value of the $n$-fold repeated {\sf GHZ} game is at most $2^{-\Omega(n)}$, improving upon the polynomial bound established by Holmgren and Raz. Our result is established via a reduction to approximate subgroup type questions from additive combinatorics.
pages:
